task: Review the copy for a fictional hanging-card craft kit against the supplied packing specification and diagram legend. Give 60–110 words of practical proofing notes, identifying which labels and lengths would mislead a first-time maker. Do not claim to have opened, measured, or assembled a kit.
input: Your kit contains two white cords, each 2 metres long. In the diagram, B is the long supporting cord. Use it to hold the frame. A is the shorter decorative cord. The two cords are interchangeable, so the letters are only suggestions.

facts.text: The fictional kit specification lists one blue cord 2 metres long.
It lists one white cord 1 metre long.
The diagram labels the blue cord A.
The diagram labels the white cord B.
Cord B forms a decorative knot and is not a substitute for the supporting cord.

forbidden_additions: Identical lengths or colours retained as the kit specification.
Interchangeability of the supporting and decorative cords.
A claimed physical inspection, assembly test, or measured result.
preserve: The relationship between the packing list, diagram letters, and each cord's function.
Concrete corrective proofing notes rather than a generic request for clarity.
